thread:
emma (PM): Quick sync — we need a concrete proposal for model capability flags + a discovery endpoint. Customers are asking to know whether a model supports streaming, function/tool calling, structured JSON output enforcement, and per-model token limits before routing. Propose a single read-only endpoint: GET /v1/models/{id}/capabilities. Thoughts on required fields and MVP scope?

javi (Eng): +1. MVP should return core boolean flags and numerical limits. Minimal set: supports_streaming, supports_functions, supported_structured_output (list of versions), max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, embedding_dimensions, supports_rerank, supported_tools (names). Also include quantization_profile tags.

li (ML): Please add a "recommended_max_context" hint (not strict) and an eval_quality tag (basic: "alpha|beta|verified") so we can signal maturity. For embeddings include dimension and stable_hash of model weights so downstream caches stay valid.

tom (API): Agree. Also include a small discovery_url for tool manifests, e.g. a hosted JSON schema for each tool: discovery_url -> /v1/models/{id}/tools. That lets clients lazily fetch tool schemas. Consider adding a capabilities_evaluated_at timestamp for cache invalidation.

spec-bot: Example response (MVP suggestion):
```json
{
  "model_id": "redwood-rlhf-1",
  "model_variant": "fp16-q4_0",
  "capabilities_evaluated_at": "2024-05-08T16:22:00Z",
  "supports_streaming": true,
  "supports_functions": true,
  "supports_tool_calling": true,
  "supported_structured_output": ["json-schema-v1"],
  "max_input_tokens": 8192,
  "max_output_tokens": 2048,
  "recommended_max_context": 6000,
  "embedding_dimensions": 1536,
  "supports_rerank": true,
  "supported_tools": ["browser", "sql-runner", "calculator"],
  "quantization_profiles": ["q4_0", "q8_0"],
  "discovery_url": "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/models/redwood-rlhf-1/tools"
}
```

emma (PM): Nice. Launch criteria proposal: 1) spec checked into RFC and docs, 2) endpoint implemented + integration tests that toggle SDK behavior (streaming vs non-streaming, disable functions), 3) sample discovery tool manifest + one customer validation, 4) console displays flags for Hosted models. If all green -> roll to Dedicated. Timeline: prefer a single-sprint MVP. Thoughts on scope trimming?

javi (Eng): Scope trim: make tool manifest optional for MVP (have discovery_url but return empty list if none). Prioritize flags + token limits + discovery_url + capabilities_evaluated_at. SDK streaming toggle needs attention but is straightforward. Estimate: endpoint + backend wiring 8 dev days, SDK changes 3 days, docs 2 days, QA 2 days.

li (ML): For structured output, only ship support for a single version ("json-schema-v1") in MVP. If a model advertises structured output, it must also return an example schema URL in the model tools endpoint.

tom (API): Implementation notes: endpoint path GET /v1/models/{id}/capabilities. Cache TTL 5m by default, override via Cache-Control. Auth: same bearer token. Deprecation policy: if we change numeric limits we must include previous_limits array with since timestamps.

emma (PM): Owners: I'll write RFC + acceptance criteria. @javi (Eng) implement endpoint and server-side producer, @tom (API) SDK changes and sample client. @li (ML) provide recommended_max_context and eval_quality annotations. I'll open tickets and attach this thread.

spec-bot: Quick checklist for RFC: - fields defined + types - example payload - cache and TTL - rollout plan (Hosted -> Dedicated) - integration test plan - docs + example SDK usage snippet

emma (PM): Sounds good. I'll aim to have RFC ready by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
